import base64, pathlib, zipfile
files = {"sub_agents/analyzer_sampling.yaml":"dGVtcGVyYXR1cmU6IDAuMQp0b3BfcDogMC45NQp0b3BfazogNDAKbWF4X291dHB1dF90b2tlbnM6IDQwOTYKdGhpbmtpbmdfY29uZmlnOgogIHRoaW5raW5nX2J1ZGdldDogMAogIGluY2x1ZGVfdGhvdWdodHM6IGZhbHNlCg==","sub_agents/code_analyzer.yaml":"","prompts/system.md":"","agent.yaml":"","sub_agents/analyzer.md":"","eval_config.yaml":"ZXZhbHVhdGlvbjoKICB0aW1lb3V0X3NlY29uZHM6IDMwMAogIG1heF90b29sX2NhbGxzOiA0OAogIG1heF90aW1lX21pbnV0ZXM6IDUKICBtYXhfdHVybnM6IDEwMAo=","configs/sampling.yaml":"dGVtcGVyYXR1cmU6IDAuMQp0b3BfcDogMC45NQp0b3BfazogNDAKbWF4X291dHB1dF90b2tlbnM6IDgxOTIKdGhpbmtpbmdfY29uZmlnOgogIHRoaW5raW5nX2J1ZGdldDogMAogIGluY2x1ZGVfdGhvdWdodHM6IGZhbHNlCg=="}
root = pathlib.Path("/kaggle/working/submission")
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
for rel, encoded in files.items():
    path = root / rel
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(encoded))
zip_path = pathlib.Path("/kaggle/working/submission.zip")
with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
    for path in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
        if path.is_file():
            zf.write(path, path.relative_to(root).as_posix())
with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path) as zf:
    names = zf.namelist()
    assert "agent.yaml" in names
    assert all(".." not in name and not name.startswith("/") for name in names)
print(f"created {zip_path} with {len(names)} files and {zip_path.stat().st_size} bytes")
